A '''dog''' had been the pet of the [[Farmer/Legends|farmboy]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] sometime before he left his [[Homeworld/Legends|home planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] aboard the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]<ref name="Novelization" /> in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Skywalker was thinking about the [[Dog/Legends|dog]] as the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|ship]] entered [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] to travel to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="Novelization" />

==Behind the scenes==
Luke Skywalker's dog was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|novelization]] of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], published in [[1976]] and written by [[Alan Dean Foster]].<ref name="Novelization" /> It is one of several mentions of real-world animals included in the novel.<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|93|May The Facts Be With You: Part One|May The Facts Be With You: Part One: #1-50}}</ref>
